verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS, not an AI coding agent or agent runtime, so restoring a coding agent's session to a checkpoint is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its MCP support and CLI let external agents work with Basecamp data, but nothing shows Basecamp hosting, versioning, or rolling back agent sessions.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
